title: Chief Chirpa
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: As the chief Ewok among the tribe of the Bright Tree Village, Chief Chirpa was reluctant to join the cause against the Empire but agreed, even adopting Luke Skywalker and the other heroes of the Rebellion into the tribe. For the battle, he organized war bands and intricate traps to fight the Stormtroopers and their war machines across the forest they called their home.
